neighbours.label: the word right after 'wide' in compounds such as 'wide-open', 'wide-leg', 'wide out'
fire: The rookie was standing wide open in the end zone.
These wide-leg trousers pair well with a simple top.
With the gates left wide open, the goats wandered away.
The election is still wide open with three weeks left.
She prefers wide-legged jeans to skinny ones.
The prairie stretched out wide and empty under the sky.
The goalkeeper left the near post wide open for the striker.
Its wide-open floor plan makes the small flat feel larger.
quiet: The rookie was standing alone in the end zone.
These straight trousers pair well with a simple top.
With the gates left open, the goats wandered away.
The election is still undecided with three weeks left.
She prefers loose jeans to skinny ones.
The prairie stretched far and empty under the sky.
The goalkeeper left the near post open for the striker.
Its open floor plan makes the small flat feel larger.

notes: Card: Wide-Legged, wide-open x4, widewide open, wide leg; ' out' x10 in top 32.
